ImageDescription.value:
There is certainly something surreal ,about this place that makes it amusingly stunning and heart chilling ... While it seems to be abondoned , and drifted to the doors of Oblivion ... There is something within the walls of this antique monument , probably 'an agonized old soul' that has witnessed the turmoils of time ...

And now , dawns upon the passersby to have them visit her in her lonely chamber and hear of her life's ballads : the ballads of love ,loss ,pain , valour and time~the invincible of them all !!....

-Rashi

They're a gift from the Netherlands to thank Canada for providing refuge to their Royal Family and the Canadian Armed Forces for helping to liberate the Dutch people during the Second World War. Every time I see the tulips I'm reminded of the bravery and sacrifice of our men and women in uniform and our continued relationship with the Netherlands.
